# `src/generated/` — generated code, do not edit

The `.ts` files here are generated by [`openapi-typescript`](https://openapi-ts.dev) from the
vendored OpenAPI specs at the repo root. This README is the one hand-written file in the
directory.

| File | Regenerated by | From |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `api-types.ts` | `npm run generate:types` | `dws-api-spec.yml` |
| `extract-types.ts` | `npm run generate:types:extract` | `dws-data-extraction-spec.yml` |

Hand-edits are overwritten on the next regeneration, and CI fails on the drift in the meantime.

**To change an API type:** update the spec, re-run the relevant script, commit both together.

Full detail — the load-bearing codegen flags, what CI does and does not enforce, and where a
hand-written type is legitimate instead — is in
[`docs/generated-types.md`](../../docs/generated-types.md). Read it before touching the flags in
`package.json`.
